title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) in the xdg-desktop-portal package for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 allows unauthorized host file access due to unvalidated FileChooser filenames. This flaw affects the D-Bus portal interfaces used by flatpak for file access and other operations. Red Hat has issued an important security update to address this issue.
